summary_en: Cacco completed acquisition of all shares of Anycloud (information services company, est. 2019, capital ¥10M, Tokyo-based). Transaction originally disclosed 27-May-2026; formal acquisition procedures finalized 17-Jun-2026. Anycloud now 100% subsidiary of Cacco. Impact on FY12/2026 earnings under review; consolidated forecast revision to follow.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Share Acquisition of Anycloud Inc. (Full Subsidiary Status) – Disclosure Progress Update
translation_en_brief: On 17 June 2026, Cacco Inc. announced completion of its acquisition of all shares of Anycloud Inc., making Anycloud a wholly owned subsidiary. Anycloud is an information services company established in June 2019, headquartered in Tokyo (Shinjuku Ward), with capital of ¥10 million and representative director Kenta Murai. The acquisition terms were originally disclosed by Cacco on 27 May 2026 via a stock transfer agreement notice; the formal acquisition procedures have now been finalized as of the announcement date. The company holds 100% of Anycloud's shares. Cacco stated that the impact of this acquisition on consolidated earnings for the fiscal year ending December 2026 is under review and will be disclosed separately when the revised consolidated earnings forecast is released.
